company: Op Methods HubSpot Automation and Process Overview

calls.title: GrowthBook + Op Methods HubSpot Automation and Process Overview
calls.summary: The team convened to optimize critical operational workflows, emphasizing the importance of campaigns like webinars and executive dinners while identifying outdated lead status processes for removal. A structured approach will be taken to organize workflows into folders for easier management. Sales engagement challenges due to fragmented notifications were discussed, proposing a streamlined notification system based on lead scoring. The transition to a lead object model aims to better align lead statuses with lifecycle stages, automating contact recycling post closed-lost deals. Data quality measures, such as honeypot fields and Zero Bounce validation, are set to enhance marketing lists. The meeting concluded with a focus on enforcing processes through training and improved follow-up task automation for events.
calls.keywords: Lifecycle stage, Workflows, Lead status, Recycling contacts, Slack notifications, Lead scoring
calls.action_items:
**Shawn Green**
Conduct a deep dive audit of contacts currently in the subscriber lifecycle stage to determine proper reclassification before removal or renaming of this stage (02:07)
Adjust the recycling workflow to use 'last engagement date' instead of 'last activity date' to prevent incorrect recycling of contacts who are actively submitting forms (17:21)
Implement automation to update lifecycle stages and recycle contacts and companies when a deal is closed-lost, enabling these contacts to re-enter the marketing funnel (13:33)
Organize all workflows into clear folders categorized as marketing, operational, and deprecated to improve auditability and management (51:18)
Schedule auto turn-off for event-specific marketing drip workflows to prevent workflow clutter and accidental re-engagement (53:56)
Add validated honeypot fields on all web forms, such as webinar signups, to reduce bot entries and improve data quality (39:51)
Coordinate with Jeff Ignacio on workflow classification and cleanup, especially regarding deprecated or unused workflows (51:18)

**Chris Newton**
Share detailed MQL workflows spreadsheet to assist in auditing and understanding workflow processes (06:17)
Review and optimize ZeroBounce segmentation and validation approach for marketing contacts to efficiently manage credits and exclude invalid contacts (42:17)
Work with sales leadership to define clear prioritization and accountability for lead follow-up, integrating Rio platform data and lead scoring hierarchy (31:16)
Assess and train sales team on effective use of Slack notifications, encouraging accountability indicators such as read receipts or response markers (27:16)
Collaborate with marketing to improve the process for task creation and sales follow-up on tiered events to reduce manual intervention (24:35)

**Lyndsie Berens**
Coordinate with Shawn and Chris to set up marketing folders for workflows and assist in workflow organization (52:10)
Provide login credentials and explanation of the Rio platform to Shawn to facilitate improved integration and lead scoring discussions (30:21)
Contribute documentation on previous Zoom enablement sessions and assist in planning future webinar-based customer training formats (23:34)
